diagnostics.name: member_login_boundary
diagnostics.sql:
SELECT MAX(last_login_date) AS anchor,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE last_login_date=(SELECT MAX(last_login_date) FROM members)-30) AS at_lower,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE last_login_date>(SELECT MAX(last_login_date) FROM members)-30) AS exclusive_count,

diagnostics.name: member_top10_cutoff
diagnostics.sql:
WITH cutoff AS (SELECT points FROM members ORDER BY points DESC OFFSET 9 LIMIT 1)
       SELECT (SELECT points FROM cutoff) AS cutoff,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE points>(SELECT points FROM cutoff)) AS strictly_above,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE points=(SELECT points FROM cutoff)) AS tied_at_cutoff FROM members

diagnostics.name: customer_top10_cutoff
diagnostics.sql:
WITH counts AS (SELECT c.customer_unique_id,COUNT(*) AS n
       FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id GROUP BY 1),
       cutoff AS (SELECT n FROM counts ORDER BY n DESC OFFSET 9 LIMIT 1)
       SELECT (SELECT n FROM cutoff) AS cutoff,
       COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE n>(SELECT n FROM cutoff)) AS strictly_above,
       COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE n=(SELECT n FROM cutoff)) AS tied_at_cutoff FROM counts

items.question: 每个月的订单量环比增长率是多少？
items.actualSql:
WITH monthly_orders AS (
  SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', order_purchase_timestamp) AS month,
         COUNT(*) AS order_cnt
  FROM orders
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT month,
       ROUND(
         (order_cnt - LAG(order_cnt) OVER (ORDER BY month))::numeric
         / NULLIF(LAG(order_cnt) OVER (ORDER BY month), 0),
         4
       ) AS mom_growth_rate
FROM monthly_orders
ORDER BY month
LIMIT 100
items.goldSql:
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', order_purchase_timestamp) AS m, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM orders GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT m AS month,
       cnt,
       ROUND((cnt - LAG(cnt) OVER (ORDER BY m))::NUMERIC
             / NULLIF(LAG(cnt) OVER (ORDER BY m), 0), 4) AS mom_rate
FROM monthly ORDER BY m
items.diagnosticTargetSql:
SELECT month,mom_rate FROM (WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', order_purchase_timestamp) AS m, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM orders GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT m AS month,
       cnt,
       ROUND((cnt - LAG(cnt) OVER (ORDER BY m))::NUMERIC
             / NULLIF(LAG(cnt) OVER (ORDER BY m), 0), 4) AS mom_rate
FROM monthly ORDER BY m) q
